verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 ships an official CLI, `s0`, hosted in its own GitHub org (sandbox0-ai/s0). The docs say it can run non-interactively in GitHub Actions for image build/push, template updates and sandbox orchestration, which supports automation and agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: CLI install and command reference docs in the pack, evidence of AI-native features (e.g., machine-readable output or agent-oriented commands), and independent hands-on corroboration.
